label_ja: 費用の年割引率
label_en: Annual discount rate for costs
notes: C2H 2026 base case 2%; deterministic range 0% to 4%. Methodological discount rates are varied in DSA but fixed in PSA.

label_ja: QALYの年割引率
label_en: Annual discount rate for QALYs
notes: C2H 2026 base case 2%; deterministic range 0% to 4%. Methodological discount rates are varied in DSA but fixed in PSA.

label_ja: 支払意思額
label_en: Willingness-to-pay per QALY
notes: Reference threshold used for NMB and CEAC; not a universal reimbursement rule.

label_ja: PCCモジュールの計算期間
label_en: PCC module horizon
notes: Ten years is long enough for the 12-month base mean duration; extended scenarios are supported. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: エンシトレルビル薬剤費
label_en: Ensitrelvir acquisition cost per PEP course
notes: JPY 7,090/tablet multiplied by 7 tablets: 3 tablets day 1 and 1 tablet on days 2 to 5.

label_ja: 経口抗ウイルス薬の投薬関連費用
label_en: Oral antiviral administration cost
notes: FY2026 fee-schedule microcost for a trial-concordant face-to-face consultation, baseline antigen test, prescription, and representative pharmacy pathway. No-test and telemedicine scenarios are supplied because testing is not stated as mandatory in the Japanese label.

label_ja: PEP導入に伴う追加アクセス費用
label_en: Additional PEP access and dispensing cost
notes: Reserved for implementation costs not captured by the itemized 2026 fee-schedule microcost, such as urgent delivery or local coordination.

label_ja: 症候性COVID-19後の入院確率
label_en: Hospitalization probability conditional on symptomatic COVID-19
notes: Untreated high-risk Japanese outpatients had 0.785% 28-day all-cause hospitalization. The model separately applies hospitalization_attribution_fraction to acknowledge that not every admission is necessarily causally attributable to COVID-19.

label_ja: 全原因入院のCOVID-19帰属割合
label_en: Fraction of observed all-cause hospitalizations attributable to COVID-19
notes: Base case links all 28-day all-cause admissions to symptomatic COVID-19; 50% and 0% structural scenarios quantify the potential optimism from this linkage. Fixed in PSA because no defensible empirical distribution was identified.

label_ja: COVID-19入院後死亡確率
label_en: In-hospital mortality conditional on COVID-19 hospitalization
notes: 12% in-hospital mortality in a Japanese claims-based inpatient cohort through January 2024. Applied only to hospitalization attributed to symptomatic COVID-19.

label_ja: 非入院症例の死亡確率
label_en: Mortality probability among nonhospitalized symptomatic cases
notes: Publication base case permits acute COVID-19 death only after hospitalization. Legacy scenarios may override this value.

label_ja: 入院後のICU入室確率
label_en: ICU admission probability conditional on hospitalization
notes: External Japanese COVID-19 model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: ICU入室後の人工呼吸器使用確率
label_en: Mechanical ventilation probability conditional on ICU admission
notes: External Japanese COVID-19 model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: 一般病棟入院中死亡確率
label_en: Inpatient mortality in general ward
notes: External Japanese COVID-19 model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: ICU非人工呼吸器症例の死亡確率
label_en: Mortality in ICU without mechanical ventilation
notes: External Japanese COVID-19 model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: ICU人工呼吸器症例の死亡確率
label_en: Mortality in ICU with mechanical ventilation
notes: External Japanese model used the same mortality for ICU with and without ventilation. The upper range is widened. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: 外来症例の症状持続日数
label_en: Duration of acute symptoms in nonhospitalized cases
notes: Seven days in the Japanese CEA; wider bounds used for uncertainty.

label_ja: 外来COVID-19のutility減少
label_en: Utility decrement for nonhospitalized symptomatic COVID-19
notes: Attributable acute EQ-5D-5L decrement in the Japanese Omicron controlled cohort: 0.873 minus 0.615 = 0.258. Bounds use the conservative cross-limit envelope 0.826-0.645 to 0.921-0.586.

label_ja: COVID-19入院中utility減少
label_en: Utility decrement during COVID-19 hospitalization
notes: Proxy based on the difference between Japanese population baseline and oxygen-requiring COVID-19 utility; broad range reflects uncertain mapping to all admissions.

label_ja: 一般病棟COVID-19のutility減少
label_en: Utility decrement for general ward COVID-19
notes: Same decrement as non-oxygen COVID-19 in the Japanese source model. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: ICU COVID-19のutility減少
label_en: Utility decrement for ICU COVID-19
notes: Difference between Japanese baseline utility 0.877 and oxygen-requiring COVID-19 utility 0.593. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: 急性期死亡1件あたりの割引済み残存QALY
label_en: Discounted remaining QALYs lost per acute COVID-19 death
notes: Age-sex weighted 2025 Japanese life-table integration at 2% discount. Base proxy age 82, 54% male; deterministic bounds use ages 85 and 75 with the same sex weights.

label_ja: 症候性外来COVID-19費用
label_en: Outpatient COVID-19 treatment cost
notes: Japanese EHR and claims based model input; update to current fee schedule if material.

label_ja: COVID-19入院1件当たり費用
label_en: Direct medical cost per COVID-19 hospitalization
notes: Median all-case cost. Bounds are the reported mild and severe medians and therefore represent case-mix scenarios, not a confidence interval.

label_ja: COVID-19入院日数
label_en: Length of stay for COVID-19 hospitalization
notes: Median 21 days in the contemporary cohort. Lower bound is the median in an independent 2021 cost cohort; upper bound is a prespecified structural range.

label_ja: 急性期費用の価格・診療差調整係数
label_en: Acute cost price and practice adjustment factor
notes: No general inflation scalar is imposed on bundled payer costs. A 0.8 to 1.2 multiplier captures price-year and practice-pattern uncertainty.

label_ja: 一般病棟1日費用
label_en: General ward cost per day
notes: Japanese EHR and claims based model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: ICU非人工呼吸器1日費用
label_en: ICU without mechanical ventilation cost per day
notes: Japanese EHR and claims based model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: ICU人工呼吸器1日費用
label_en: ICU with mechanical ventilation cost per day
notes: Japanese EHR and claims based model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: 一般病棟在院日数
label_en: Length of stay in general ward
notes: Japanese EHR and claims based model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: ICU非人工呼吸器在院日数
label_en: Length of stay in ICU without mechanical ventilation
notes: Japanese EHR and claims based model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: ICU人工呼吸器在院日数
label_en: Length of stay in ICU with mechanical ventilation
notes: Japanese EHR and claims based model input. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: 生存した症候性COVID-19 1例当たり感染後1年QALY損失
label_en: One-year post-acute QALY loss per surviving symptomatic COVID-19 case
notes: Area between retrospectively recalled COVID-19 and symptomatic test-negative EQ-5D-5L profiles from months 1 to 12. The source was a single-clinic online recall survey with 77 controls, a 28.3% response rate, and no pre-test baseline utility. Conservative scenarios exclude the 6-to-12-month interval, halve the integrated loss, or remove post-acute loss entirely.

label_ja: 生存した症候性COVID-19 1例当たり感染後直接医療費
label_en: Post-acute direct medical cost per surviving symptomatic COVID-19 case
notes: No sufficiently transportable Japanese matched incremental direct-cost estimate was identified. Base is zero; JPY 50,000, 100,000, and 200,000 scenarios are reported.

label_ja: 症候性非入院感染後のPCC発生確率
label_en: PCC probability after nonhospitalized symptomatic COVID-19
notes: Base case uses the excess prevalence attributable to infection: 11.8% in cases minus 5.5% persistent symptoms in controls. Scenario uses gross 11.8%. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: 入院症例におけるPCCリスク倍率
label_en: PCC risk multiplier after hospitalization
notes: Japanese severity-specific PCC incidence is not established for the modeled setting. The probability is capped at 1. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: 無症候感染後のPCC発生確率
label_en: PCC probability after asymptomatic infection
notes: Excluded in the base case. Used only in the any-infection PCC scenario. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: PCC平均持続期間
label_en: Mean duration of PCC
notes: One-year base case is aligned with a prior Japanese COVID-19 CEA; five-year scenario is provided. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: PCCのutility減少
label_en: Utility decrement for PCC
notes: Difference between 0.877 baseline and 0.850 among Japanese patients with persistent symptoms in the source model. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: PCC年間直接医療費
label_en: Annual direct medical cost of PCC
notes: No robust Japanese estimate was identified for the model target. The payer base case is conservative at zero; JPY 50,000 and threshold scenarios are provided. Legacy incidence-duration model only in v0.2.0.

label_ja: PEPによる増分有害事象費用
label_en: Incremental adverse-event cost attributable to PEP
notes: Adverse-event rates were similar between arms; base incremental cost is zero.

label_ja: PEPによる増分有害事象QALY損失
label_en: Incremental adverse-event QALY loss attributable to PEP
notes: Adverse-event rates were similar between arms; base incremental QALY loss is zero.

label_ja: 直接予防した症候性症例1例当たりの追加下流症候性症例
label_en: Additional downstream symptomatic cases per direct symptomatic case
notes: Base case is zero. Exploratory generation-1 bounding scenarios use 0.2 and 0.5 additional symptomatic cases per direct symptomatic case. These are not fitted transmission estimates and do not constitute a dynamic transmission model.
